claims.statement: The 5 November UK parliamentary critical-minerals report identifies dependence on China-dominated processing and a 10–15 year horizon for diversifying supplies; it proposes financing and allied procurement, not confirmed newly operating capacity.

On 5 November Maersk said Q3 freight rates increased 46% quarter-on-quarter while ocean volumes were broadly flat year-on-year, and revised 2026 underlying EBITDA guidance to $14–14.5 billion. Prices and expected earnings are not direct measures of physical capacity or monopoly rent.

On 5 November the IRGC asserted two tankers and a tugboat had caught fire around Hormuz; the claim was not independently verified by AP. Vessel identities, overlap with earlier allegations and verified loss of shipping capacity remain unestablished.

UKMTO said a separate tanker north of Qatar was struck by two projectiles at 23:20 GMT on 4 November, reported on 5 November. Crew status, damage and lasting disruption were unknown; this must not be conflated with IRGC vessel claims.
